scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “Bounded klt complements for Fano contractions” (preprints/Bounded-klt-complements-for-Fano-contractions-September-25-2026/Bounded-klt-complements-for-Fano-contractions-September-25-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 066 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d50937326c7cb115), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 3. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every positive integer d and positive rational number ϵ there is a positive integer N = N(d, ϵ) with the following property. Let k be an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, and let f : X → Z be a projective surjective morphism of normal integral k-varieties such that f∗OX = OZ, dim X = d, KX is Q-Cartier, X is ϵ-lc, and −KX is ample over Z. For every closed point z ∈ Z there are an effective Q-divisor B on X and a Zariski open neighbourhood U of z such that (X, B) is klt over U and N(KX + B)|f−1(U) ∼ 0 is an integral Cartier divisor.
